## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `anyshot-Setup-{{version}}-x64.exe` | Windows 10 and 11 on Intel or AMD (x64) |
| `anyshot-Setup-{{version}}-arm64.exe` | Windows 11 on ARM (ARM64) |
| `anyshot_{{version}}_amd64.deb` | Debian, Ubuntu and their derivatives (x64): `sudo apt install ./anyshot_{{version}}_amd64.deb` |
| `anyshot-{{version}}-x86_64.AppImage` | Any x64 Linux distribution: `chmod +x` the file and run it |
| Source code (zip) | The source at this tag |

The Windows installers are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn the first time: choose **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
